title: Convergence of the mollified test functions against μ: ∫(∫ζ(y)ρ_j(y − z)dy)dμ(z) → ∫ζ dμ (parent Step 3)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^N, ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ continuous with compact support, and δ ∈ ℝ with μ(cthickening(δ, tsupport ζ)) < ∞. For j ∈ ℕ let ρ_j : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with ρ_j ≥ 0, ∫ ρ_j dL^N = 1 and tsupport ρ_j ⊆ B̄_{r_j}(0), where r_j ∈ ℝ satisfy r_j ≤ δ for all j and r_j → 0. Then ∫ (∫ ζ(y)ρ_j(y − z) dL^N(y)) dμ(z) → ∫ ζ dμ as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), Continuous ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → μ (Metric.cthickening δ (tsupport ζ)) < ∞ → (∀ j, Continuous (ρ j)) → (∀ j y, 0 ≤ ρ j y) → (∀ j, ∫ y, ρ j y = 1) → (∀ j, tsupport (ρ j) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) (r j)) → (∀ j, r j ≤ δ) → Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ z, (∫ y, ζ y * ρ j (y - z)) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, ζ z ∂μ))
